title: Law to bar candidates from taxpayer-funded ads near elections
summary: This bill would amend the City Charter to prohibit a public servant who is running for elected office, or their spouse, from appearing in any government-funded third-party public communication, such as social media posts, during the 90 days before a primary or general election. It defines third-party public communication as content whose author is not a public servant or agency, or is not clearly identified as one. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
